text:
maria: Quick thread to nail down the Dedicated reserve + burst story for the roadmap. Want a small, implementable set of defaults + a low-risk pilot path. Points: SKU names, burst semantics, carryover policy, autoscale cooldowns, and UI/billing basics.

ajay: For distinct branding let's use SKUs: launch (1 GPU-eq), team (4 GPU-eq), forte (32 GPU-eq). Each maps to a reserve band and a suggested SLO.

ben: Infra reality: big-model cold boots 2-4m; KV-cache drain ~25-40s. To avoid churn we should set scale_down_cooldown to 180s and scale_up_window ~45s as defaults.

tal: UX ask: surface a "reservoir" concept in Console. Customers buy a reservoir (USD-minutes) and pick a burst band. Make carryover an explicit checkbox on purchase.

sophia: Finance/legal preference is USD-minutes as the billing unit. Carryover only with explicit opt-in and a recorded acceptance. Also need simple contract language for pilot customers.

rachel: Support/ops: soft-throttle with clear 429 + guidance reduces escalations. Also recommend an automatic fallback route to a smaller model variant when reservoir is exhausted.

maria: Proposal from product: reservoir windows per SKU: launch=10m, team=30m, forte=12h. Carryover: off by default; opt-in allowed for forte with a pilot. Soft-quota default; hard block only for contractual add-ons.

ben: Example feature-flagged config we can ship quickly:

```
reserve_defaults:
  launch: {gpu_eq:1, burst_window:"10m", min_replicas:1, max_replicas:2}
  team: {gpu_eq:4, burst_window:"30m", min_replicas:1, max_replicas:8}
  forte: {gpu_eq:32, burst_window:"12h", min_replicas:4, max_replicas:64, carryover_allowed:true}
autoscale:
  scale_up_window:45s
  scale_down_cooldown:180s
  preempt_policy:"opportunistic-first"
  soft_quota_default:true
```

ajay: Good. Also add a simple weight-based preempt table so we can evict bursty opportunistic slots before paid reserves.

tal: Console flow idea: Buy reservoir -> choose burst band -> toggle "carryover (forte only)" -> confirm. Show live "remaining USD-minutes" and a download link for ledger CSV.

sophia: Pilot plan: enable carryover for up to 3 forte customers behind a flag for 2 months to validate billing and audit trails. Finance will invoice USD-minutes and show token equivalence in UI.

rachel: Telemetry request: emit metrics quota_exhausted, quota_throttled, fallback_used, preempt_evicted. That will help SRE & support.

maria: Prioritization suggestion: 1) soft-quota + clear throttle UX, 2) reservoir ledger + Console counter, 3) tiered windows, 4) carryover pilot for forte. Rollout via feature flag.

ben: Rough effort: backend ledger + quota hooks (3 sprints), autoscale/preempt policy work (2 sprints), Console + billing integration (2 sprints), QA/docs (1 sprint). Feature-flag rollout lowers risk.
ajay: For roadmap doc I'll draft pricing bands (USD/minute) and SLO targets against each SKU.
tal: I'll produce a quick mock of the purchase + ledger UX by Tue.
sophia: I'll prepare opt-in language and pilot billing workflow by Tue.
rachel: I'll draft a support playbook and fallback guidance by Wed.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: Dedicated Reservoir Pilot Kickoff Thu 10:00. Invite sent.

maria: Ok locking these decisions for the Q3 roadmap draft: SKUs = launch/team/forte, reservoir windows 10m/30m/12h, carryover opt-in for forte via pilot, soft-quota default, cooldown=180s, billing unit USD-minutes. Action owners noted above. Add quick objections here, otherwise we'll move forward.

ajay: no objections from me.

maria: thanks everyone :rocket:
